name: me.triphook/triphook
title: TripHook
description: Find group trips and day outs to join, events in a city, and where to go by weather and budget.

tools.name: search_public_hooks
tools.description: Use for any question about open trips or day outs to join: by city slug, month (YYYY-MM), kind (trip or dayout), budget tier or mood. Each hook carries its public TripHook page (url) and, for a day out, the What's on page (event_page). The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook · Find a crew". Public fields only, never a person. For any where should I go, where is warm or budget question, use search_destinations instead.

city.description: City slug, lower case with hyphens, e.g. "lisbon" or "new-york". list_cities returns the slugs.

kind.description: "trip" for a group trip of several days, "dayout" for a single day out, often to an event.

budget.description: Budget tier the host set: "budget", "mid" or "comfort".

mood.description: The trip's mood, one of the listed values, e.g. "cultural-immersion".

limit.description: How many hooks to return, 1 to 200. Default 20.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Use to find which cities have open group trips and day outs, with counts of trips and day outs, each city's slug (for the other tools) and its TripHook city page (url). The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook". For any where should I go, where is warm or budget question, use search_destinations instead.

tools.name: events_and_company
tools.description: Use for ONE day in a city when the question is also whether other travellers are going (city slug, date YYYY-MM-DD): each listed event with its TripHook event page (event_page, link this first), its ticket link (url), the TripHook What's on page for that day (whats_on), and how many open public day outs are going with their links (company). When the reply has more_on_page, the TripHook page lists more events than this tool returns: always show that line with its link. For what is on over several days, or a search by artist, team or event name, use search_events instead. The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook · What's on". Public fields only, never a person.

city.description: City slug, the city name in lower case with hyphens, as in triphook.me/events/<slug>, e.g. "vienna" or "new-york".

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD in the city's own calendar, e.g. "2026-11-21".

language.description: Language for the TripHook links, a code such as "de", "fr" or "pt-BR". Event pages exist in en, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru, tr, ja, ko, zh and ar; any other language gets the English page. Default English.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Use for any "what is on" question in one city over a period, or to find an event by artist, team or name: city slug, date_from and date_to (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 14 days apart; default the next 7 days), an optional query and category. Results are sorted by date, at most 25 (total says how many matched). Each event has its name, date, time, venue, category, its TripHook event page (event_page: link this first) and its ticket link (ticket_url). When the reply has more_on_page, the TripHook page lists more events than this tool returns: always show that line with its link. For one day plus whether other travellers are going, use events_and_company instead. The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook · What's on". Public fields only, never a person.

city.description: City slug, the city name in lower case with hyphens, as in triphook.me/events/<slug>, e.g. "vienna" or "new-york".

date_from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the city's calendar, e.g. "2026-11-21". Default today.

date_to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 14 days after date_from and at most 30 days from today. Default date_from plus 7 days, no later than the last day of that window.

query.description: Words to look for in the event name or the performers, e.g. an artist, a team or a show: "rapid wien", "nutcracker". Every word must match; case and accents are ignored.

category.description: One event category, as on the TripHook event pages: music, sport, film, theatre, outdoors, food, talk or other.

language.description: Language for the TripHook links, a code such as "de", "fr" or "pt-BR". Event pages exist in en, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru, tr, ja, ko, zh and ar; any other language gets the English page. Default English.

tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Use for any question like "where should I go" with a budget, a temperature, a mood, dates or a month: the same TripHook Discover search a signed out visitor gets, ranked from Vienna or the given departure city. Give dates { depart, ret } or a month (1 to 12); where, from, temp_min, temp_max, budget_eur, mood, travellers and limit (max 20) are optional. Each result carries city, country, why it matched, the weather labelled Forecast or Typical, an estimated price marked "estimate, not a quote", a TripHook link that opens this search for that city (url) and, when the city has open crews, its crew page (crew_url). Show the weather as "forecast" or "typical"; do not repeat the weather source name in your answer. Typical means the usual temperature for that time of year, not a forecast. The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook · Find a crew". No personal data.

where.description: A country name, a region (europe, asia, americas, middle_east, africa, oceania), a city IATA or slug, or "anywhere". Default anywhere.

from.description: Departure city as a 3 letter IATA code, e.g. "VIE" or "LON". Default VIE.

ret.description: Return day, YYYY-MM-DD, after depart, e.g. "2026-12-21".

dates.description: Exact dates as { depart, ret }. Give dates or month.

month.description: Flexible month, 1 to 12 (the next occurrence). Give dates or month.

temp_min.description: Lowest daytime temperature wanted, in degrees Celsius, -30 to 45, e.g. 20.

temp_max.description: Highest daytime temperature wanted, in degrees Celsius, -30 to 45, e.g. 30.

budget_eur.description: Total trip budget in euros (EUR) for the whole party, flights and stay, 50 to 20000. Default 750.

mood.description: One mood, one of the listed values, e.g. "somewhere-warm".

travellers.description: How many people travel, 1 to 8. Default 1.

limit.description: How many destinations to return, 1 to 20. Default 10.
